thread:
claire (release-manager): Heads-up: starting release window for payments-v2 chart. Found a flaky admission webhook behavior in staging that could reject older releases. Thinking we should hold the canary until we pin a compatible chart and promote the image. Any objections?

alice (eng): What webhook error are you seeing? logs?

claire (release-manager): stack trace from staging controller: `Failed to decode admission review: unknown field \"policy\"` — looks like CRD validation changed between chart 1.4.0 -> 1.5.0. Canary is pinned to 1.5.0 in deploy plan.

ben (platform): If the webhook schema changed, rolling back to 1.4.x chart might avoid the admission error. We can also add an admit-hook toggle in values to skip validation for canaries.

dave (sre): Skipping webhook in prod is risky. Strong preference: keep webhook, but we can pin chart to 1.4.0 for the early canary subset (10%). If stable, roll forward and run CRD migration job during maintenance window.

emi (qa): Repro steps in staging: helm upgrade --install payments -f canary-values.yaml payments/chart --version 1.5.0, create Payment CR with new metadata -> webhook rejects. With chart 1.4.2 same CR is accepted.

claire (release-manager): Proposal: hold current canary, change canary chart version to 1.4.2, push image promotion plan, add a post-rollout job to run CRD migration and run full regression in the nightly window. Release notes should call out CRD schema bump.

deploy-bot: Canaries: 2/4 healthy. Auto-pause engaged for manual review. Details: https://deploys.internal/redwood/payments/canary/2432109876

frank (pm): Important to include migration opt-out flag for customers in release notes. Also add a rollback paragraph in case post-migration errors surface.

alice (eng): How do we pin the chart in the CI pipeline? I can open a tiny PR to values-override. Steps: update helmfile entry -> set chart.version: 1.4.2 and re-run `./ci/deploy-canary.sh --env=staging`.

ben (platform): I'll watch the deploy bot. If you push the values-override PR I'll also add a temporary routing rule: route 10% traffic to the pinned canary pool running chart 1.4.2. If stable for 2h we can trigger promote.

claire (release-manager): I'll draft release notes snippet: \"payments: reverted canary chart to 1.4.2 due to admission webhook schema change; CRD migration scheduled in nightly window. Customers may see flag 'migration_opt_in' default false.\"

emi (qa): After PR lands I will run the regression checklist: payments e2e flows + webhook acceptance tests. ETA 45m.

dave (sre): If webhook continues failing after pin, we prepare rollback plan: immediate chart pin back to previous working default + scale down new replicas. Add steps: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/payments --to-revision=REV` and remove the canary routing rule.

claire (release-manager): Ok agreed. Action items: 1) alice PR for values-override -> set chart.version=1.4.2 (alice) 2) ben temporary 10% routing + watch (ben) 3) emi run tests (emi) 4) claire update release notes + post-rollout migration job (claire) 5) dave standby for rollback (dave).

alice (eng): PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/9876 — includes values override and a one-line comment explaining why.

deploy-bot: CI: canary deploy started for payments (chart=1.4.2) by alice. Build: sha:abc123. Canary pool: r5g-small.

emi (qa): Canary passed acceptance tests (webhook ok) — no rejects observed. Running smoke for 15 more minutes.

frank (pm): Good signal. Claire, once promote happens, please push a short note to #announcements and include migration opt-out in docs.

claire (release-manager): Will do. Promote plan: after 2h stable canary we cut a promote PR that updates main chart version to 1.5.0 plus migration job. But we will instead: 1) promote image only to prod using chart 1.4.2; 2) schedule CRD migration in next nightly window; 3) after migration, upgrade chart to 1.5.0. That minimizes customer impact.

dave (sre): Sounds safe. Keep autoscaling cool-down longer during promote window. I'll set node pool surge buffer + monitor P99 latency.

claire (release-manager): Closing hold. Rolling the canary with pinned chart and promoting image only. Release notes draft attached in PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary promote executed by ben. traffic-weight: 10% -> 50%. Monitor: https://deploys.internal/redwood/payments/2432109876/monitor

emi (qa): Post-promote sanity checks passing. No webhook rejections observed in prod canary logs.

claire (release-manager): Final: proceed with scheduled nightly CRD migration. Will update #announcements with timeline and rollback instructions.

frank (pm): Add a short blurb to the customer-facing changelog about the migration flag and expected behavior.

(THREAD END)
